purpose.zh: 手臂撑地、肩膀往下压把身体撑起，练背部两侧
purpose.en: Press your shoulders down through straight arms to lift your body and work the sides of your back.

text.zh: 手臂伸直，肩膀往下压把臀部撑起
text.en: Keep your arms straight and press your shoulders down to lift your hips

text.zh: 坐在地上腿伸直，双手撑在臀部两侧。
text.en: Sit with your legs long and your hands on the floor beside your hips.

text.zh: 顶端停2秒，肩膀远离耳朵。
text.en: Hold for two seconds at the top, shoulders away from your ears.

commonErrors.en: Bending the elbows to push up.

cautions.zh: 先活动一下手腕，手腕刺痛或发麻时停下
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists first, and stop if they feel sharp pain or numbness.
